SELECT t1.id, t1.order_id, t4.order_no, t4.customer_id, t7.name AS customer_name, t1.product_id, t2.name AS product_name, t2.version_id, t1.batch_id, t5.batch_no, t1.order_structure_id, t1.element_id, t6.name AS element_name, t1.spec, t1.price, t1.quantity, t1.unit_value, t1.discount_rate, t1.amount, t1.note, t1.status, t1.cut_quantity, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.creator, t1.updater FROM zc_sales_order_material t1 LEFT JOIN zc_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 JOIN zc_sales_order t4 ON t1.order_id = t4.id AND t4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_product_batch t5 ON t1.batch_id = t5.id AND t5.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_curtain_structure_element t6 ON t6.id = t1.element_id AND t6.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_customer t7 ON t7.id = t4.customer_id AND t7.deleted = 0
ORDER BY t1.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t1.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(t1.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM zc_sales_order_material t1 LEFT JOIN zc_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 JOIN zc_sales_order t4 ON t1.order_id = t4.id AND t4.deleted = 0

SELECT m.product_id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, m.spec AS spec, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity), 0) AS quantity, MAX(m.unit_value) AS unit_value FROM zc_sales_order_material m INNER JOIN zc_sales_order o ON m.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_product p ON m.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.product_id IS NOT NULL AND o.confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND o.confirm_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.confirmTime[0]} AND #{reqVO.confirmTime[1]} GROUP BY m.product_id, p.name, m.spec ORDER BY m.product_id ASC, m.spec ASC
